name: News source URLs in cards use HTTPS
description: The URLs in news card links should use secure HTTPS protocol, not plain HTTP or data URIs.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match to open a match detail page
Verify that visible news card links or URLs in the news panel use https:// URLs, not http:// or data: or javascript: URLs. Hover over a card or inspect the visible URL text to confirm HTTPS usage.
